text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead to the Japan Derby, Duramente asked 
to add more practice races, as a countermeasure 
for her habit of getting carried away in a race.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
But in my view, the real cause was that 
her field of vision was narrowing. 
What she needed was training to widen it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Just as her vision opened up when she responded to my call 
at the Satsuki Sho, she had to extend her senses... 
training to "connect" with the world around her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
I asked Neo Universe to teach her. Through meditation 
and standing under the waterfall, Duramente 
succeeded in "connecting" with the world.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
She can now take in a race from above. 
Her vision will not narrow on her again. 
At the Japan Derby, her strongest run should be within reach.
